summary: Read one singly linked chain. From the head, group the nodes into successive neighboring couples, and inside each couple exchange the two nodes' places. When the length is odd, the final unpaired node stays in its original place. Only the links between nodes may change, and the integer saved in each node keeps its original value. Write the head once the exchanges are finished.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a node count followed by the integer stored in each node.
